runtimeScope.sharedModelRule: multiple editors may attach the same model; a model mutation and marker change fan out to every attachment, while each editor's per-editor state remains independent
runtimeScope.disposalRule: disposing an editor removes its process editor-registry entry and per-editor state; it never disposes an externally supplied model or unrelated global registration

cases.baselineTrigger: the construction option model field is omitted
cases.behavior: create a new process-registered model from value or empty raw UTF-16 and the selected or inferred language; attach it and mark it editor-owned
cases.lifetime: the editor disposes this model on first detach, replacement or editor disposal

cases.baselineTrigger: the construction option model field contains a live model
cases.behavior: attach the exact model reference and ignore construction value and language for model creation
cases.lifetime: replacement or editor disposal detaches but never disposes the model

cases.baselineTrigger: the construction option model field is explicitly null
cases.behavior: create no model, attach nil and ignore construction value and language for model creation
cases.lifetime: a later mapped setModel may attach an external model

editorModelConstruction.swiftUIRule: the SwiftUI wrapper accepts the same discriminant at construction and never represents editable text as String state; after mount, attachment identity changes route through mapped setModel and never recreate an implicit model from a changed value
editorModelConstruction.explicitCreateModelOwnership: editor.createModel's native mapping always returns a caller-owned process-registered model; editors attaching it remain borrowers

registrationOrdering.languageProviders: higher selector score first; at equal score non-builtin precedes builtin and later registration precedes earlier registration; an effective exclusive selector suppresses all other providers
registrationOrdering.commands: latest registration of one command ID executes first; disposing it reveals the prior registration; a returned disposable is idempotent
registrationOrdering.instanceAddCommand: mapped IStandaloneCodeEditor.addCommand returns an ID, installs a process-global dynamic command and keybinding, and has no public disposal handle, matching the pinned baseline lifetime
registrationOrdering.instanceAddAction: mapped addAction is editor-ID context gated and its returned disposable owns the command, menu, keybinding and editor-action entries
registrationOrdering.theme: defineTheme replaces the named definition; redefining the active theme refreshes it; an unknown setTheme name selects the builtin light theme

largeModelPolicy.creationHardLimit: none beyond representable indices and available process memory

derivedCacheManifest.rule: every strong derived cache in a product target registers one stable ID and records owner scope, key, maximum entries or bytes, eviction order, invalidation epochs, memory-pressure action and instrumentation counter
derivedCacheManifest.closedSet: the linked product cache registry and MonaCacheManifest IDs must be set-equal; an unregistered strong derived cache is a release failure
existingHardBounds: layout records and surfaces use the V1-R3 viewport and generation formulas
Metal atlas has at most 16 pages when Metal exists

derivedCacheManifest.buildSpecificBounds: all remaining cache bounds are immutable fields of the candidate revision's generated manifest and are measured by C09 and every P workload

resourceOwnership.memoryPressure: evict recomputable unpinned derived caches and cancel stale unpublished proposals; never discard or rewrite semantic state, a prepared commit or an in-flight presented frame
resourceOwnership.fatalOOMBoundary: Swift runtime or operating-system fatal out-of-memory termination is outside the recoverable-error claim, as it is for the browser comparator; no release statement may claim survival from fatal OOM

failureInjection.recoverableAllocationCheckpoint: the test SPI denies repository-owned fallible resource requests before mutation or publication; synchronous baseline APIs without an error channel preserve their public signature and expose the injected failure only to the test observer
requiredResults: no partial model root, event batch, registry entry or renderer generation is published

failureInjection.forbiddenClaim: a simulated checkpoint is not evidence that arbitrary Swift heap exhaustion is recoverable
